name: Sisterhood One Day - TEAM
description:
Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God's mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship. Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God's will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will.
- Romans 12:1-2

name: Welcome to Church RTM
description:
If you are new to our church, we would love to invite you to our "Welcome to Church" event!

We have Welcome to Church after each service.

This is a great opportunity to learn more about who we are, our heart, our vision, our mission, and to meet some of the team who help make our community feel like home.

We would love to hear any questions you may have, and we will do our best to provide answers and guidance.

Simply sign up, and we will be in touch with all the details. We can't wait to meet you!

name: Youth Night
description:
If you are aged 11 - 18 then Y&F night is for you.

Besides having fun and making new friends, you'll experience powerful worship and hear an inspiring message that equips you to get closer to God and live the life of impact that He has in store for you.

Join us at 19:00 in the Oosterkerk (Kleine Wittenburgerstraat 1) and bring your friends!
